purpose: Two explicitly labeled exploratory DEMO setups; no profitability qualification.

setups.trend_reclaim: A: existing completed-context trend and entry EMA20 reclaim, including existing RSI gates, unchanged.
setups.trend_sweep: B: same completed-context directional trend; buy when the latest entry candle has a low strictly below the previous 20 entry candles' lowest low, then closes bullish and strictly above that prior low; sell is the exact reverse. The signal candle is excluded from the prior range. No EMA20 crossover or additional RSI threshold is imposed on B.

shared_filters: Existing warmup and recent continuity; Gold volatility 0.75-1.75 and maximum 2.5 ATR signal range; exact broker symbol, fresh quote and closed-candle freshness; original structural/ATR stops, adaptive 1R-4R targets, spread/slippage and broker admission checks.
arbitration: One decision and at most one send attempt per symbol/candle. Opposite directions skip both. Same-direction overlap chooses A and records B as overlap. Otherwise choose the unique setup. Do not fall back to another setup after planning rejection or a failed/uncertain send.
risk: Shared 1% baseline; existing qualified minimum-lot-only exception up to 2%; 2% combined account ceiling; one position per instrument, maximum two account-wide. No extra risk budget per setup.
documentation: Record both technical decisions, chosen setup, overlap/conflict and planning rejection; actual trades retain setup identity and broker-verified cashflows. Independent replay accounts are hypothetical and separate from the actual shared-account experiment.
research: Compare A alone, B alone and A-priority combined on the same archived period and costs, at USD500 and USD1000. Include doubled-slippage stress for the combined USD500 account. Freeze definitions; no search or tuning after results. History was previously examined and is development data, not a clean holdout. No actual historical financing ledger; retain the existing explicit modeled-cost caveats.
execution: DEMO only, existing explicit activation deadline, no forced entry, no order retry, no real account connection or self-modification.
